blocks.html: This reference shows all the events emitted by the Arcangel application related to the Order Module. If you use the module outside the Arcangel application, these events aren't emitted.

events.name: order.updated
events.description:
Emitted when the details of an order or draft order is updated. This
doesn't include updates made by an edit.

events.name: order.placed
events.description:
Emitted when an order is placed, or when a draft order is converted to an
order.

events.name: order.canceled
events.description: Emitted when an order is canceld.

events.name: order.completed
order.archived
events.description: Emitted when an order is archived.

events.name: order.fulfillment_created
events.description: Emitted when a fulfillment is created for an order.
events.payload:
```ts
{
  order_id, // The ID of the order
  fulfillment_id, // The ID of the fulfillment
  no_notification, // (boolean) Whether to notify the customer
}
```

events.name: order.fulfillment_canceled
events.description: Emitted when an order's fulfillment is canceled.
events.payload:
```ts
{
  order_id, // The ID of the order
  fulfillment_id, // The ID of the fulfillment
  no_notification, // (boolean) Whether to notify the customer
}
```

events.name: order.return_requested
events.description: Emitted when a return request is confirmed.

events.name: order.return_received
events.description: Emitted when a return is marked as received.

events.name: order.claim_created
events.description: Emitted when a claim is created for an order.

events.name: order.exchange_created
events.description: Emitted when an exchange is created for an order.

events.name: order.transfer_requested
events.description:
Emitted when an order is requested to be transferred to
another customer.

events.name: order-edit.requested
events.description: Emitted when an order edit is requested.
events.payload:
```ts
{
  order_id, // The ID of the order
  actions, // (array) The [actions](https://docs.arcangel.com/resources/references/fulfillment/interfaces/fulfillment.OrderChangeActionDTO) to edit the order
  no_notification, // (boolean) Whether the customer shouldn't be notified of the requested order edit. Available since v2.19.0.
}
```

events.name: order-edit.confirmed
events.description: Emitted when an order edit request is confirmed.
events.payload:
```ts
{
  order_id, // The ID of the order
  actions, // (array) The [actions](https://docs.arcangel.com/resources/references/fulfillment/interfaces/fulfillment.OrderChangeActionDTO) to edit the order
  no_notification, // (boolean) Whether the customer shouldn't be notified of the order edit, as stored on the order change when the edit was requested. Available since v2.19.0.
}
```

events.name: order-edit.canceled
events.description: Emitted when an order edit request is canceled.
